appearances.title: Tencent releases Hy4 with vision and computer use
appearances.summary: Tencent released Hy4 with image understanding and computer use across command-line and graphical interfaces. It is available on Tencent Cloud and OpenRouter at the preview API price, with a 1 million token context window, and the company said the weights and a system card will follow.
